prs.title: Fix `token_expiry_time` upon context initialization for stored tokens.
prs.author: keurcien
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: After a client restarts and reloads tokens from storage, token_expiry_time is never repopulated from the stored expires_in value, so is_token_valid() treats a stale/expired access token as valid. members.cluster_pick_reason: Both add an in-flight duplicate-id guard in _handle_post_request, but #3221 generalizes the fix: #3063 keys on `str(request_id)`, which collapses distinct JSON-RPC ids like int 1 and string "1" into the same slot (false 409, or a missed collision) and doesn't guard against a string id equal to GET_STREAM_KEY hijacking the standalone GET stream slot. #3221 introduces a type-preserving `_request_stream_key` (prefixing int vs str ids) that fixes both edge cases while solving the identical underlying race described in #3060.
